criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.assessment: Purdue GIS FID 266 and Purdue facilities history identify the Animal Holding Facility; Indiana's separate 2018 footprint independently corroborates it. The raw GIS outline has 16 vertices, and each transformed vertex is within 0.000051 m of a reopened mesh vertex.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.assessment: Reopened world bounds are X [-65.6451187133789, -23.69708824157715], Y [-1030.836669921875, -955.23193359375], Z [0.0, 5.999149322509766] m. GIS source outlines preserve the modeled plan orientation; Purdue and Indiana footprints agree within 0.50 m centroid offset and 1.74 m maximum symmetric boundary residual. The model's roughly 0.18 m envelope expansion is documented as wall/trim thickness.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.assessment: Independent sampling of the raw 2018 Indiana 5-ft NDHM reproduces 614 north/main cells (median 4.036 m) and 359 south-addition cells (median 5.166 m). Four spatial-bin sizes give south-zone Y trends of -4.752% to -4.022%; the saved asset models a low slope there. Purdue GIS reports one level. NDHM is a normalized surface raster rather than an eave survey, so exact structural pitch, zone seam, and roof heights remain estimates.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.assessment: The saved asset is a neutral, unfenestrated envelope without a modeled entrance. The 2026-10-26 follow-up found a webcam view described as the Large Animal Hospital complex and State Budget Committee minutes describing a Phase III addition/renovation; neither identifies an AHF facade or supplies a plan/elevation. The earlier public search also documents a null archive image field. No facade features can be credited from this evidence.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.assessment: Blender 4.5.15 LTS reopened the expected named collection with 1 mesh object, 368 vertices, 304 faces, no modifiers or external images, and zero boundary/non-manifold edges. The collection also links into a clean factory-startup scene. Building-specific evidence includes raw GIS, orthophoto, and NDHM snapshots, reproducible scripts, profile analyses, reopen checks, and a preview.

evidence.render: audit/animal_holding_facility_independent_grade_r6/reviewed_asset_preview.png (directly inspected; neutral blank envelope and two roof zones)
evidence.orthophoto: audit/animal_holding_facility_independent_grade_r6/reviewed_orthophoto_overlay.png (directly inspected; supports roof plan/color zones only)
evidence.additional_search_interpretation: Adds project history/context but no identifiable facade, plan, elevation, or entrance evidence.

findings.finding: No AHF-specific facade photograph, measured elevation, plan, or entrance evidence was found in the documented public searches. The building remains a blank envelope, so the facade criterion is unverified and the grade is below the 8/10 pass threshold.

The modeled south roof slope agrees with broad NDHM surface trends at four bin sizes, but the raster is not a structural roof or eave survey and may include equipment, normalization artifacts, or edge contamination.
The north/main roof is held at its median because its fitted trend is weak and unstable. The 2023 orthophoto supports roof color zones, not roof heights, structure, or exact seam.
The exact saved asset blob matches candidate c40be18; Blender reopened it with a closed manifold mesh and successfully linked the expected collection into a clean scene.
